book.title: 摊铺机铺出一条新马路
book.subtitle: 公园门口的最后一段接力
book.question: 摊铺机怎样把路面铺得平整？

moral.zh: 前一道做好，后一道接稳，合作让长长的路连起来。
moral.en: Prepare each stage and support the next so teamwork can connect a long road.

parentGuide.goal: 理解有先后关系的合作。
parentGuide.reminder: 不把施工流程背诵当作考核，让孩子用自己的话讲接力。
questions: 运料、摊铺、压实怎样接上？
车走了为什么还不能马上踩新路？
parentGuide.activity: 用纸片拼一条路，找空缺和接缝，再用玩具车演一遍运料、摊铺、压实。

ageTips.age4to5: 每次听几个动作就好，允许配音、指图和重复最喜欢的一页。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子解释一次遇到困难后的选择，比较两种车的分工，不要求背术语。

pages.zhText: 公园快开放了，门口还差一段连接道路。安安从围栏外看见几辆不同的工程车：“今天谁先来，谁最后来呢？”
pages.enText: The park was almost ready, but a connecting road was missing. An'an saw several machines beyond the fence. “Who goes first, and who comes last today?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide park entrance closed roadworks paver dump truck roller waiting separate areas visitors outside fence.

pages.zhText: 林工程师拿出没有字的小图卡：运料、摊铺、压实。“今天是一次接力。”安安把卡片排好：“我来记住顺序！”
pages.enText: Lin brought wordless picture cards: deliver, pave, compact. “Today's a relay.” An'an arranged them. “I'll remember the order!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Visitor shelter three distinct picture cards truck paver roller at table An'an Mom Lin.

pages.zhText: 先检查路下面的基础。标高、平整、排水和需要的处理都准备好，才能铺上面。妈妈说：“漂亮的路面，也需要可靠的底下。”
pages.enText: First came checks of the base: level, shape, drainage and required treatment. “An attractive surface needs sound support underneath,” Mom said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Professional surveying prepared road base with drainage curb, paver parked waiting.

pages.zhText: 运料车送来沥青混合料。里面有石料，也有起黏结作用的沥青。它和给平台用的混凝土不同，可不能认成同一种材料。
pages.enText: The truck brought asphalt mix: stone bound with bitumen. It was different from the concrete used for the platform; the two were not interchangeable.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Visitor safe sealed samples dark asphalt and light concrete alongside, actual covered delivery truck background.

pages.zhText: 今天用的是热拌材料，施工区域很烫，必须隔开。安安站在参观区捏捏妈妈的手：“我们只看，不靠近、不伸手。”
pages.enText: Today's hot-mix material made the work area hot and off-limits. An'an held Mom's hand in the visitor area. “We look without going close or touching.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide protected visitor fence substantial standoff from hot asphalt receiving operation, subtle heat haze only.

pages.zhText: 绿色摊铺机张着宽宽的料斗，像在等一份大午饭。运料车按现场指挥慢慢到位，确认配合好，才向料斗卸料。
pages.enText: The green paver's broad hopper seemed to await a giant lunch. Under site guidance, the truck approached slowly and unloaded only when everything was aligned.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Blue dump truck rear properly aligned to green paver front hopper, coordinated safe feed, workers clear.

pages.zhText: 哗啦，材料落进料斗。安安问：“它吃进去以后，从哪里出来？”林工程师让她看看摊铺机身后的方向。
pages.enText: The mix poured into the hopper. “Where does it come out after going in?” An'an asked. Lin pointed toward the back of the paver.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close front receiving hopper asphalt arriving, rear screed visible deeper behind coherent machine.

pages.zhText: 机器里的输送装置把材料送向后面，再由螺旋分料器向左右分开。这样，宽宽的路面才都有材料铺上。
pages.enText: Conveyors carry the mix rearward, and augers distribute it sideways. That supplies material across the full paving width.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Educational safe parked museum model paver with small sectional cutaway showing front hopper conveyor rear auger, wordless no people near active mechanisms.

pages.zhText: 后面的熨平板像一位细心的整理员，帮助铺出设定的宽度、厚度和平整度。不是安安家里熨衣服的那一块小板子哦。
pages.enText: The screed behind carefully shapes the planned width, thickness and evenness. It is not the little iron used for clothes at home!
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low rear-quarter green paver screed laying uniform dark asphalt mat, professional operator on safe platform.

pages.zhText: 摊铺机保持合适的速度，一条黑亮的新路慢慢伸出来。安安用手指在空气里画长线：“这条线，要一直接得顺顺的。”
pages.enText: At a suitable steady speed, the paver left a fresh dark strip. An'an drew a line in the air. “Let's keep it smooth and connected.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Long cinematic paver moving steadily leaving smooth fresh asphalt strip behind toward park gate.

pages.zhText: 下一辆运料车还没到，大家先联系确认。材料供应要衔接好，突然断断续续，会给摊铺带来麻烦。安安说：“接力不能只顾自己跑！”
pages.enText: The next delivery had not arrived, so the team checked in. Supply needed coordination; interruptions could complicate paving. “A relay isn't just about your own turn!” An'an said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Paver operator communicating by radio, adequate hopper material still present, next truck distant on safe approach.

pages.zhText: 现场按照材料状态和施工方案调整安排。需要暂停，就把停工和接缝处理做好；不是随便等一等，再接上就算完成。
pages.enText: The team adjusted the work to material condition and the paving plan. Any pause needed proper stopping and joint treatment, not simply waiting and starting again.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Controlled paving pause neat transverse stopping edge professional crew working safely PPE, machine stationary.

pages.zhText: 运输接上了，摊铺继续向前。接缝处也要认真处理，让新铺的部分和前面的部分按要求连好。安安说：“拼图的边边也很重要。”
pages.enText: With delivery restored, paving continued. Joints needed care so sections connected as required. “Puzzle edges matter, too,” An'an said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close professional screed laying adjoining asphalt section at neat joint, no gaping cracks.

pages.zhText: 压路机跟上来，按材料和温度要求压实。摊铺机负责铺，压路机负责压；看着平整，还要把里面做好。
pages.enText: The roller followed, compacting according to material and temperature requirements. The paver laid it; the roller compacted it. A smooth look was only part of the job.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide green paver ahead orange tandem roller behind with safe spacing new asphalt mat no close workers.

pages.zhText: 工作人员检测路面的情况，也检查边缘、排水和接缝。安安问：“所以最后一辆车走了，还没到我们上场的时候？”
pages.enText: Workers checked the surface, edges, drainage and joints. “So even when the last machine leaves, it isn't our turn yet?” An'an asked.
pages.illustrationPrompt: PPE inspector checking finished asphalt edge beside drain after machines parked, fence still closed.

pages.zhText: 还要等冷却、检查合格，并由现场确认开放。围栏没有撤，大家就继续从安全的临时通道走。妈妈说：“我们也帮接力守好最后一步。”
pages.enText: The road needed cooling, successful checks and approval to open. While barriers remained, everyone used the safe temporary path. “We help by respecting this final step,” Mom said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Family follows fenced pedestrian detour away from new asphalt closed lane, paver parked distant.

pages.zhText: 回家后，安安把玩具车排成队：前面送材料，中间铺，后面压。她推到一半停下来：“前面的还没准备好，后面的先等等。”
pages.enText: At home, An'an lined up toys: deliver, pave, compact. Halfway through, she paused. “If the first stage isn't ready, the next one waits.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Home toy dump truck paver roller orderly separated sequence An'an narrating Mom listens.

pages.zhText: 妈妈用卡纸做一条路，安安一段段拼好。哪条接缝最整齐？哪里漏了一小块？她拿起小纸片：“我来补上这个空缺！”
pages.enText: Mom made paper road pieces, and An'an fitted them together. Which joint was neatest? Where was a gap? “I'll fill this space!” she said.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Inside cozy living room only, An'an and mother join gray cardstock road segments on low table; child holds matching piece to fill visible gap. No engineer, outdoors or real construction vehicles; no scissors.

pages.zhText: 现在请你来当故事里的小调度员：石料刚送到，应该请摊铺机先铺，还是让行人先走？安安把公园门口的小人留在围栏外。
pages.enText: Be the story's little planner: when material arrives, should paving happen first, or should people walk on it? An'an kept the toy visitors outside the barrier.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Toy roadwork paver and truck with toy visitor figures behind mini fence, sorting game no labels.

pages.zhText: 道路开放了，公交车稳稳停在公园站。安安和妈妈从人行道走进公园：“谢谢接力小队，把回家的路和公园连起来啦！”
pages.enText: When the road opened, a bus stopped at the park stop. An'an and Mom entered from the sidewalk. “Thank you, relay team, for connecting our neighborhood to the park!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Finished safe park entrance road public bus stopped curb, family walking on separated sidewalk warm welcoming.

imagePromptKit.globalStyle: Use case: illustration-story. One square full-bleed warm premium children's picture-book illustration, softly textured animated-film realism, rich cinematic natural light, rounded tactile forms, Chinese neighborhood park construction project beside a stream. Vary perspectives and compositions; illustrate the specific story moment rather than a generic parked vehicle.
imagePromptKit.characterConsistency: An'an (安安): six-year-old Chinese girl, ear-length straight black bob, yellow star hair clip, teal hooded jacket, blue jeans, orange backpack, white sneakers with red trim. Mom: shoulder-length black hair, coral cardigan, cream trousers, tan shoulder bag. Recurring engineer Lin: Chinese woman with tied-back dark hair, white hard hat, orange reflective vest, navy trousers and work boots. During active construction An'an and Mom stay together OUTSIDE a sturdy fenced visitor area, well away from machinery. Only trained adult workers in hard hats, reflective vests and boots enter work zones. Home scenes have no worksite hazards. Same deep-green tracked asphalt paver with front receiving hopper, concealed conveyors and rear screed; blue-cab gray dump truck supplies asphalt; orange tandem steel-drum roller compacts. Asphalt dark realistic, only subtle heat haze no smoke clouds.
imagePromptKit.negative: No text, letters, labels, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, vehicle faces, injuries, dangerous imitation, children operating machinery or entering active sites, people under suspended loads, workers in vehicle blind spots, duplicated characters, malformed limbs or impossible vehicle mechanics.
